clips.title: The story
paras: Thork needs the Crossroads defended as Razormane quilboar cut its supply roads. Their ambushes have halted caravans from Durotar, and the outpost is running short on food and gear. You strike at the quilboar while scouts search for the one directing their warband.

The Crossroads guards a key junction for Horde traffic through central Kalimdor. Freight wagons and caravans bring food, iron, and equipment west from Durotar, and the outpost depends on those supplies. Razormane ambushes along the northeast trails have stopped the deliveries. Stores are running low, and Thork cannot wait for peaceful talks.

Thork sends you against the quilboar bramble dens northeast of the settlement before they can assault the town walls. Striking their Water Seekers, Thornweavers, and Hunters weakens the Razormane scouting perimeter and deprives raiding parties of magical and logistical support. These skirmishes buy time while Horde trackers search the brush for the one organizing the raids.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: All the quilboars are our enemies, friend. Some just prove to be more of a nuisance than others.

The Razormane tribe has been attacking our supply lines from Durotar, causing us no end of annoyance. I have scouts seeking the leader of these raids, but until then, any losses you can inflict on the filthy pig men would aid us.
Start in the northeast towards Durotar. You can always tell their dens from the huge thorny vines that come up from the earth. Seek them out, and slay them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The longer it takes to stop these attacks, the harder it will be to provide supplies for the people of the Crossroads.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. Those insolent quilboars will finally learn that the might of the Horde is not to be ignored.
